body:
This issue tracks three **already corrected and independently re-reviewed artifact findings** from the worker01 single-case canary for `mediadive.ingredient:1944`. It is a workflow evidence record for coordinator verification, not a new scientific defect or a request to edit MIM records. The canary depends on #1158; the separate source defect remains tracked in [KG-Microbe #1824](https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/issues/1824).

| Finding | Observed artifact problem | Correction and evidence | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IR-DRAFT-1 | Cross-repository issue numbers in the source-finding draft could resolve in the wrong GitHub repository. | Corrected to explicit KG-Microbe issue URLs and qualified MIM dependency/context links. `captures/independent_review/issue-draft-review-v2.json` accepts the corrected draft; `captures/issue-filed-1824.json` and `issue-filing-receipt.json` verify the published source issue matches it. | Resolved; independently re-reviewed. |
| IR-DRAFT-2 | The draft and research interpretation described this specific source ChEBI cross-reference as automatically assigned, although the page only says most identifiers were automatically matched. | Changed the draft to “source cross-reference” and the research index to distinguish the general disclaimer from the unknown assignment mechanism. Raw primary captures remain unchanged. Corrected draft and `captures/primary_context/research-evidence.json` were re-reviewed. | Resolved; independently re-reviewed. |
| IR-VALIDATION-1 | An early unstaged whitespace-check PASS did not cover the then-untracked evidence; the full staged check reports whitespace/CRLF retained in immutable source captures. | Ran and retained both full and scoped checks. Full staged check exits 2 on nine captured HTML/header files; authored artifacts pass the scoped check. `report.md` and `pr-body.md` explicitly disclose this and do not treat the early check as final coverage. Raw evidence was not reformatted. | Resolved; independently re-reviewed. |

All paths below are relative to `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/canary/` on the assigned evidence branch `review/all-unmatched-w01-source-review-20261107`:

- `captures/independent_review/issue-draft-review-v1.json` preserves the original draft findings; `captures/independent_review/issue-draft-review-v2.json` preserves re-review.
- `captures/independent_review/staged-whitespace-check.json` and `authored-whitespace-check.json` retain exact commands, exits and their distinct scopes.
- `captures/independent_review/final-content-review-v1.json`, SHA256 `1bf2a87132675d3c4fe0023a723f180b0ddd4fd449ced4ab5f60262f544ab751`, lists all three findings as resolved, with no open in-scope artifact finding. It binds the reviewed scientific payload and evidence inventory.
- `captures/independent_review/final-metadata-review-v2.json`, SHA256 `ae00ffc5001ae973e9b1c4e3a554f372dc2375657651590aff330e5ce2aa7ecd`, rechecks metadata and the coordinator's count precision: 14,406 file-content hashes comprise 14,405 Git regular files plus the dereferenced CLAUDE.md file-symlink target; both tracked symlink targets separately match baseline Git blobs. It supersedes the earlier metadata receipt for publication.
- `review-dispositions.json` and the forthcoming final metadata re-review retain this tracking link and the publication boundary. Earlier captures are immutable; later receipts add observations rather than rewrite history.

Reviewer identity is the separate in-process Codex agent `/root/skeptical_review`, which did not author the decision or source research. This is not human scientific sign-off. Source identity, recipe interpretation, no-change disposition, current MIM/export bytes and all existing scientific holds are unaffected by these artifact corrections.

The findings are resolved in the evidence bundle. Keep this tracker available for coordinator verification of the final pushed canary PR and exact-head receipt; no merge, issue closure, mapping approval or source-data edit is requested by this issue.

The original observations are preserved in [finding 7/8](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/artifact-findings-v7-v8.json), [finding 9](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/artifact-finding-v9.json), [finding 10](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/artifact-finding-v10.json), [finding 11](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/artifact-finding-v11.json), [finding 12](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/artifact-finding-v12.json). Earlier positive reviews that missed alias projection, gas-component assertions or dependent-reference failures are superseded for those specific conclusions, as recorded in [the assurance correction](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/coordinator-findings-1167-1168-independent-supersession-v1.json).

Publication review also identified **IR-PUB-ARTIFACT-1** (a prose formatter inserted spaces inside seven exact proposal IDs) and **IR-PUB-ARTIFACT-2** (JCM 1462 text inferred 0.4 mg/L from 0.4 mg plus 1 L added water). This successor restores the exact identifiers, uses literal batch wording, and preserves the rejected publication draft. [Publication review](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/publication-artifact-review-v1.json); the [independent publication rereview](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/publication-artifact-rereview-v2.json) confirms both corrections across all ten bodies.

The author’s betaine-variant and titanium stock corrections remain in [root source corrections](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/root_substances/author-corrections-v2.json). Separate coordinator issues retain their own scopes: [#1163](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1163) for completeness, [#1164](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1164) for parent predicates, [#1166](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1166) for the two cross-source duplicates, [#1167](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1167) for atmosphere versus material parts, and [#1168](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1168) for dependent UW references.

The [final independent scientific review](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/final-188-scientific-review-v1.json) covers all 188 source-case outcomes and 76 exact isolated proposals, and confirms IR1–12 plus the five coordinator corrections. It retains specific source and owner limitations. No maintained integration, inherited hold release, merge or issue closure is claimed. The independent reviewer is the in-process agent `/root/skeptical_review`; this is not human sign-off.
